title: Bat for Lashes · What's a Girl to Do?
description: A wet ribbon of road disappears into a hand-built nocturnal forest. Moonlight, mist and small lanterns follow the singer.

performance.lyrics: walked arm in arm, I didn't feel his touch. desire I'd first tried to hide, that tingling inside was gone. And when he asked me, do you still love me? I had to look away. didn't want to tell him my heart was colder with each day when you Ah Ah That's where the thrill is going And your kisses and I are replaced with tears When you're dreams are on I'm trained to train right now Then I ask you now, what's there going to do? He said he'd take me away. We would work things out and I didn't want to tell him it was then that I had to say, over the times we shared, it's all blackened out. My back -lightening heart wants to fly away. you've lost so long that the thrill is gone Ah And your kisses and I are placed for tears When your dreams run, Ah train to train Ah Ah Ah Ah What's it good to do Ah What's it going to do Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah -ha -ha -ha -ha
